events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known professionally as Sting, the iconic frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting at 75
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, what's your favourite track from the Geordie icon?

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod 25th
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Today marks 25 years since Apple dropped the device that changed how we listen to music. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day 2026
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the very first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 with a look back at the iconic films. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, Somerset.

angles.name: John Cleese at 87
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment?

events.title: The White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. A double LP packed with classics, what's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury death anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 59 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a turning point, what's your favourite track from this influential album?

events.title: John Lennon death anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: On this day 46 years ago, the world lost a musical icon. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring legacy of peace and music.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the influential British musician, was born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Bowie 80 Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. Forever pushing boundaries and inspiring generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Aaron Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', was born on January 8, 1935, in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: Elvis 92 Tribute
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English musician, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, was born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Jimmy Page at 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff from the guitar god?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Roderick David Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter, was born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Rod Stewart at 82
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! What's your favourite song from the legendary rocker?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, was born on January 13, 1961.

angles.name: Suggs at 66
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the brilliant Suggs! What's your favourite Madness anthem to get you skanking?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Antony Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away', was born on January 17, 1956.

angles.name: Paul Young at 71
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the blue-eyed soul sensation, Paul Young! What's your go-to track from the 80s hitmaker?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Dolly Rebecca Parton, the legendary American country music singer-songwriter, was born on January 19, 1946, in Sevier County, Tennessee.

angles.name: Dolly Parton at 81
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! Queen of Country, songwriter, and all-round legend. What's your favourite Dolly moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow was born on January 20, 1971, in Frodsham, Cheshire.

angles.name: Gary Barlow at 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting superstar, what's your favourite Gary track?
